title: Custom theme workflow

install.basis: real candidate source checkout in its repository virtual environment

terminal.program: Talaria via POSIX PTY on macOS

actions:
Created and selected a custom theme, changed its stored canvas and reloaded in the same live session; retained Ready transcript and controls changed from dark to purple.
Fetched an imported theme through a served source, changed its stored canvas and reloaded locally; the imported theme remained active with the local maroon canvas.
Changed the served upstream canvas and explicitly fetched again; the canvas became green, distinguishing upstream reimport from stored-file reload.

expected.text: Satisfy the named live matrix case through the real application and connected gateway.
